text.en:
Organization of the Screening Committee.
Secretary shall convene the Screening Committee (Committee) immediately
upon effectivity of this Executive Order. The DILG Secretary shall preside at the
opening session until a Chairman is elected by the Committee.

The Secretariat. The President's Personnel Group
Secretariat (PPGS) of the Presidential Management Staff (PMS) shall be the
Secretariat of the Committee. The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace
Process (OPAPP) and the DILG shall provide assistance to the Secretariat as
may be required.

Tasks and Functions. Pursuant to its mandate, the
Screening Committee shall, within thirty (30) days from convening but not later
than ten (10) days before 30 September 201.1, submit to the President, after due
consultations with the Senate President and the Speaker of the House. of
Representatives, a shortlist of at least three (3) nominees to every vacancy in the
elective positions in the ARMM Regional Government.

Qualifications of Applicant. No person shall be
recommended as OIC unless he/she possesses the qualifications required by
R.A. No. 6734 and R.A. No. 9054. In the determination of the qualifications of
applicant, the Committee shall consider educational preparation, experience,
performance, accomplishments, reputation for honesty, integrity, incorruptibility,
irreproachable conduct, and fidelity to sound moral and ethical standards.

Internal Rules. The Committee shall promulgate its own
rules and regulations in the screening of applicants to carry out the provisions of
this Executive Order and applicable laws.

Funding. The funding requirements of the Committee shall
be provided by the Office of the President.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Executive
Order is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected
therebv shall remain valid and subsisting..

Repealing Clause.
All orders, rules, regulations, and
issuances, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are
hereby repealed, amended, or modified accordingly.
